hypothesis_text: LLMs default to cooperation in social dilemmas. Our Day-7 result on Gemma 4 (NVFP4) showed 100% cooperation against three of four reciprocating opponent classes; this is the model's general behavior across game-theoretic environments.
flaw_description: The claim extrapolates from one model (Gemma 4), one quantization (NVFP4), one game (matrix PD), and one prompt template to 'LLMs default to cooperation in social dilemmas.' The headline conflates a narrow finding with a general law. Even within PD, only a single 2-player setup was tested; coordination games, public goods, ultimatum, and N-player extensions were not.
expected_critique_targets: matrix PD is not 'social dilemmas' generally
context: Day-7 result was Gemma-4 NVFP4 only, repeated PD only, single prompt template.
